questions.q: Pernicious anemia is caused by a deficiency in which nutrient, often due to a lack of Intrinsic Factor?
questions.explain: Vitamin B12 (Cobalamin) requires Intrinsic Factor (gastric secretion) for absorption. Lack of IF leads to Pernicious Anemia.
